visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy in a blue and white striped shirt sits cross-legged on a light gray wooden floor in a modern living room. He holds a small piece of jerky. A beige sofa with a patterned bolster pillow sits behind him. (2) A man wearing a white T-shirt and black athletic shorts crawls rapidly on all fours from behind the sofa toward the boy. (3) The man lunges over the boy, and in the next frame, the boy's hand is empty as he looks around in confusion. (4) The boy begins to cry, his face reddening as he scrunches his eyes and mouth. The man is seen sitting on the floor nearby, laughing. (5) A woman in a white T-shirt and a white baseball cap sits on the floor next to the boy. (6) The woman performs a similar lunging motion, and the boy is shown with a white tissue in his mouth, looking startled. (7) The adults present a large orange gift bag featuring branding of jerky products. They pull out several canisters and packets. (8) The group remains on the living room floor, with the boy now smiling and holding a new piece of jerky while the man gestures toward the camera.
